exercises.title: Part 1 · 1
exercises.prompt: Email What kinds of emails do you receive about your work or studies?

exercises.title: Part 1 · 2
exercises.prompt: Do you prefer to email, phone or text your friends? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 3
exercises.prompt: Do you reply to emails and messages as soon as you receive them? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 4
exercises.prompt: Are you happy to receive emails that are advertising things? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 2 · 1
exercises.prompt: Describe a hotel that you know. You should say: where this hotel is what this hotel looks like what facilities this hotel has and explain whether you think this is a nice hotel to stay in.

exercises.title: Part 3 · 1
exercises.prompt: What things are important when people are choosing a hotel?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 2
exercises.prompt: Why do some people not like staying in hotels?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 3
exercises.prompt: Do you think staying in a luxury hotel is a waste of money?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 4
exercises.prompt: Do you think hotel work is a good career for life?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 5
exercises.prompt: How does working in a big hotel compare with working in a small hotel?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 6
exercises.prompt: What skills are needed to be a successful hotel manager?
